newsitem.title: INDIA: India copper prices not hit by tender cancellation.
newsitem.headline: India copper prices not hit by tender cancellation.

text.p: Indian copper prices were unaffected on Wednesday by news that state-owned Hindustan Copper Ltd had cancelled a import tender for 30,000 tonnes, dealers said.
But other factors led to an overall fall in the market, they said. "Industrial demand remained low while increased arrivals of the imported metals dragged prices down," one dealer said.

Nickel fell by 300 rupees to 37,200 rupees. It was down by 500 rupees last week. Ready copper slid by 50 rupees to 11,650 rupees against a similar fall last week. Aluminium fell by 50 rupees to 7,200 rupees. Tin and lead were unchanged.
